purpose: Define per-resource minimum IAM assurance requirements evaluated alongside AccessCore authorization, with optional resource-specific reauthentication and bounded lifetime.

topics.name: Assurance-Gated Resource Access
topics.purpose: Define per-resource minimum IAM assurance requirements evaluated alongside AccessCore authorization, with optional resource-specific reauthentication and bounded lifetime.

semantics.decision_rule: Access requires both sufficient AccessCore authorization and sufficient IAM assurance where a minimum is declared.
semantics.orthogonality_rule: Authorization and assurance are separate predicates.
semantics.reauth_rule: Insufficient assurance may produce explicit reauthentication-required state.
semantics.resource_rule: Resource may declare required assurance level and allowed reauthentication methods.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Resource-specific elevated assurance may have explicit bounded lifetime.
semantics.rotation_rule: Successful reauthentication may rotate keys/credentials where the owning policy requires it.
semantics.nonexpansion_rule: Higher assurance never expands resource rights beyond AccessCore authorization.

invariants.rule: AccessCore activation, login, assurance and runtime protection are explicit lifecycle semantics; once active, AccessCore cannot be silently bypassed or disabled by an ungoverned runtime/config mutation.

hard_gates.condition: resource-specific elevation leaks globally without policy

prose.summary: Define per-resource minimum IAM assurance requirements evaluated alongside AccessCore authorization, with optional resource-specific reauthentication and bounded lifetime.
